attchmntText: Triveni Turbine Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Triveni Turbine Limited filed an investors presentation for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, with the BSE and NSE. The document outlines the company's performance and market position. Triveni Turbines is described as a top two global manufacturer of industrial steam turbines with over 6000 installations in more than 80 countries. The presentation highlights a revenue compound annual growth rate of 26 percent per annum from fiscal year 2022 to fiscal year 2026. EBITDA grew at 29 percent per annum, while profit before tax increased at 31 percent per annum during the same period. Profit after tax grew at 7 percent per annum. Order bookings showed a compound annual growth rate of 18 percent per annum from fiscal year 2022 to fiscal year 2026. The company emphasizes its focus on renewable energy solutions and refurbishment services.

attchmntText: Triveni Turbine Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 11, 2026, titled "Investors  brief for Q2 & H1 FY27 ended on September 30, 2026".
voiceSummary: Triveni Turbine Limited announced financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations for Q2 FY27 stood at 4.91 billion, down 3.0% year on year. Profit after tax was 533 million, a decline of 41.7%. For the half year, revenue increased 6.4% to 9.34 billion, while profit after tax fell 32.9% to 1.04 billion. Order booking for Q2 reached a record 7.64 billion, up 17.2%. Half year order booking was 13.33 billion, up 12.2%. The closing order book stood at 24.53 billion, up 10.5%. Export order booking grew significantly, contributing 48.1% of Q2 bookings. Aftermarket closing orders more than doubled to 6.39 billion. The company cited margin pressure due to product mix and costs but expects improved performance in the second half of the fiscal year.

attchmntText: Triveni Turbine Limited has informed the Exchange about Giving guarantees/indemnity/ becoming a surety for third party
desc: Giving guarantees/indemnity/ becoming a surety for third party
voiceSummary: Triveni Turbine Limited Board approved Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated net profit after tax was 1,044 million for the six months ended September 30, 2026, compared to 1,558 million in the prior year period. Standalone net profit after tax was 1,060 million for the same period. The Board also approved the enhancement of a Corporate Guarantee in favor of Triveni Turbines Africa Pty Limited for a working capital facility. The meeting was held on November 11, 2026.
